about_the_game:
A visual novel about the daily life of an all-girls' dormitory manager. The sequel to Girls' Dorm.

Gameplay & Features

  • Three adorable heroines

  • Full professional Japanese voice acting

  • High-quality CG viewer and scene replay

  • Simultaneous multi-language display support

Story

Despite having started by chance, Haruto’s relationship with Rin, Hiyori, and Aiko has not broken, but only grown stronger.

That said, their relationship is one they need to keep a secret between the four of them.

Characters

Rin Natsumi

CV: Kazane

Second-year at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

A sharp-tongued lone wolf, as her looks suggest… but surprisingly spoiled and childish with those she opens up to. Quite teasable once you get to know her.

Though able to handle her parents’ strict education without trouble, as a result, she is somewhat insensitive to those who struggle to do the same.

"I-I didn't say it because I want to make you feel better! Would you stop making that gross smirk?!"

Hiyori Akishima

CV: Musubi Aono

Second-year at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

Your regular punk chick at first glance, but in reality is just a lonely, self-centered girl.

It’s cute once you realize the reason behind her curfew-breaking and mischievous behavior.

Despite her deep knowledge of the arts, she seems to have little use for it, and only really uses it to decorate her room.

Starved for affection due to her parents’ hands-off approach to her upbringing, she is treated like a problem child who plays tricks on anyone and everyone.

After Haruto scolds her harshly, she becomes a little more obedient, but ultimately she enjoys teasing him for attention.

"Nihihi, don't worry! I don't fib."

Aiko Fuyusaki

CV: Sarah Ayumi

Second-year at Sakuraba Girls' Academy.

A kind, if slightly naive young woman.

Her almost overly trusting personality makes one feel rather protective of her.

After enrolling in the academy, she developed a keen interest in shojo manga, as well as the idea of meeting her Prince Charming.

For that reason, she nearly falls in love at first sight when Haruto suddenly appears at the dorm.

But as the days go by, her frustration mounts as she struggles to find a way to approach him.

However, an unexpected event suddenly pushes their relationship forward…!

"Th-That's fine! I have nothing to hide. Ask me anything!"
